title: Calculating Interest Over Years
code:
#Calculating Interest Over Years

capital = float(input("Startup capital ($$$.cc): "))
interest_rate = float(input("Interest rate in percents (xx.xx): "))
years = int(input("How many years? "))
year = 1

while year <= years:
    interest = capital * interest_rate / 100;
    print("Earned $", interest, "in year", year)
    capital += interest
    year += 1

print("Capital afrer", years, "years in bank is $", capital)

lines.explanation: Taking capital amount as user input and storing it in the variable 'capital'
Taking interest rate as input from the user and storing it in the variable 'interest_rate'
Taking number of years as input from the user and storing it in the variable 'years'
Integer '1' is assigned to the variable 'year'. This variable will be used later as the condition for the 'while' loop
Initializing 'while' loop. This loop is set to iterate until year is less than or equal to years that was given as input by the user
This is the formula to calculate the interest, when the capital and interest rate are known
Printing out the interest of each year
Updating the value of capital by adding the interest earned in that year
Updating the value of 'year'. This value has to be updated for the loop to give correct results. If this value is not updated, the loop will run indefinitely

lines.code: print("Capital afrer", years, "years in bank is $", capital)
lines.explanation: Once the condition is False, the program breaks out of the loop and prints out the total capital after certain amount of years
